text:
message: Hello my dear brother, I am from a poor family, please help me, my children are hungry
reply: 👋😁 Greetings in the name of our LORD Jesus Christ! ✝️
reply: 🙇 In the name of the Father, and of the Son, and of the Holy Spirit ❤️✝️🕊️ : May the LORD richly bless your family!
May the LORD help you!
May the LORD feed your children! Amen! 🙏
reply: 🙏 Sorry, I have nothing that I can give you at this time. According to the desire of the LORD: May the LORD provide and may the LORD lead you to someone who will abundantly provide whatever you ask the same day you ask.
